messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp goes live / external load test in ~48h (Wed 10:00 PDT). Not an incident, but this is customer-impacting and under SLA. Leaving handoff notes here for the oncall rotation.

alex: TL;DR: primary risk is bursty write path when cache warms. Autoscaling config looks OK but there's one outstanding change in infra PR that affects max replica limit.

alex: Key contacts: @mira (account lead), @sam (SRE on shift overnight), Acme SCC: acme-oncall@acme.com (we have a pager for them).

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled load test window: Wed 10:00-12:00 PDT. Target RPS ~12k. Canary to 10% for first 10m.

mira: Thanks — added to account brief. Alex, can you paste the PR link + the expected impact if it doesn't land?

alex: PR: https://git.internal/repo/infra/merge_requests/2916 — it raises the maxReplicaCount from 50 -> 120 for the VIP pool. If it doesn't land we risk queueing and increased latencies during 75th-95th percentile. Fallback: manual scale-up (kubectl scale) + enable burst pool.

sam: I can cover the overnight handoff and be online at 07:30 PDT. If we need a manual scale, call me and I'll run the scale command. Also adding a quick runbook check:
```
# quick replication check
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/vip-serving -w
kubectl get hpa -n prod vip-serving -o wide
```

julie: Small note — there's one last config tweak in my PR for cache TTLs that improves cold-starts. It's low-risk but would help reduce initial write spikes. Targeting merge tonight.

mira: I pinged Acme to confirm their internal abort window and will share the contact for the test lead. Also flagged the SLA clause about 99.9% availability during rolling maintenance.

sam: Cool. Can someone add an alert for queue depth > 5000 tokens/min for vip-serving? I set a temporary dashboard panel.

alex: Done — alert created: vip-serving.queue_depth > 5000 for 5m -> oncall. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/serve/vip-serving

ops-bot: @sam assigned to oncall shift 2024-06-21 07:30-19:30 PDT.

mira: One more ask — if we see backpressure, prefer degrading to the L2 model variant (lower mem) rather than dropping requests. Adding rollout policy note in the handoff doc.

alex: Added rollout preference and step-by-step manual fallback in the handoff doc: https://docs.internal/runbooks/acme-launch-handoff. Please ack when you've read.

sam: Acked. Will monitor logs + token queue, and will keep this thread updated if anything unusual. :eyes:

julie: Acked. I'll try to merge the cache TTL PR tonight; if it fails I'll post blocker here.

mira: Acknowledged. I'll be on standby for customer comms during the window. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
